sentences.text: The petitioners has filed reference petition under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the redetermination of the compensation amount awarded in respect of land bearing block No.153/5, 153/A and 153/B total measuring 36 guntas situated at Amminabhavi Village, Dharwad Taluk.
The reference court fixed the market value of the subject land at Rs.22,500/- per gunta.
The petitioners state that the enhanced compensation with all statutory benefits is deposited by the respondents herein.
2. The petitioners filed an application for release of the amount.
However, the same is objected by the alleged purchaser of the subject lands.
Petitioners' grievance is that though the application was filed in the year 2017, the Trial Court has not considered the application filed by the petitioners.

3. Therefore, it is expedient to dispose of the petition directing II Additional Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.),
Dharwad to consider the application submitted by the petitioners for release of the compensation amount deposited in LAC No.60/2012, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of two months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order.
